schema.description:
Result of `POST /v1/admin/domains/:id/verify`. `status` reflects the
DB-stored verification state after the run; `checks` is the per-record
breakdown the panel renders.

items.description:
One row in the verify response. `actual` carries free-form hint text
in addition to the observed value so the verify flow can express
`missing` / `drift` / `unreachable` / `verified` states uniformly.
items.title: VerifyCheck

schema.title: VerifyResponse
